svg.aria-label: Sluice as a hydraulic sluice. Water, standing for data, is released from a header tank (ADLS Gen2) through a sluice gate into an open flume, where a paddle wheel counts the inflow. A clarifier settles the raw water until it runs clean (ingest), a pump lifts it through a turbine meter into a cistern on legs (SQL merge), and the portal console's centre-zero gauge compares the two meters until it returns to zero (reconcile).
